# Binaries the repository is allowed to contain, pinned by sha256.
#
# `.github/scripts/scan_blobs.py` rejects every non-text file that is not
# listed here. Adding or replacing a binary is therefore a deliberate,
# reviewable edit to this file; no automated upstream merge can approve one.
#
# Format:  <sha256>  <path>  # note
#
# Removing a line, or changing the bytes of a listed file, blocks the build
# until the new hash is registered here.
